scenario: Offline replay of newer source criteria against older synthetic records; not historical or current enrollment eligibility
diagnosis_duration_rule: For preliminary analysis only, use the earliest retained exact-coded T2D Condition recorded_date (onset_date only if recorded_date is missing). Describe it as documented history, not proof of the true first-ever diagnosis date.
preserve_unknowns: Do not reconstruct historical source status, actual use, adherence, missing negative history, actual trial dates or consent capacity.
recruitment_rule: Retain the trial snapshot and status; do not infer availability at assessment_date or current availability.
